description: Security descriptor for MAE Autonomous Customer Data Operations Platform

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.BulkJobOperator
scopes.description: Create, monitor, cancel, and reprocess bulk jobs

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.BulkJobAnalyst
scopes.description: View job results, failure analysis, and executive summaries (read-only)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.BulkJobAdmin
scopes.description: Full administrative access to all bulk job data

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.CopilotUser
scopes.description: Interact with the DUCI Operations Copilot

role-templates.name: BulkJobOperatorRole
role-templates.description: Operations staff who create and manage bulk jobs

role-templates.name: BulkJobAnalystRole
role-templates.description: Analysts who review job results and generate reports

role-collections.name: DUCI_MAE_Operators
role-collections.description: DUCI Operations team bulk job operators
